sloka: किं शेषमिव लोकस्य हतवीरस्य साम्प्रतम् ।रणे राक्षसशार्दूले प्रसुप्त इव पांसुषु ।। ६.११२.९ ।।
transliteration: kiṁ śeṣamiva lokasya hatavīrasya sāmpratam ।raṇe rākṣasaśārdūle prasupta iva pāṁsuṣu ।। 6.112.9 ।।

translations.english: "With the tiger among the Rakshasas fallen asleep like this in the dust in the battlefield, strength of the people departed. What is left in this world?"
